    66→**Where IC, FAR, height, and coverage are calculated:**
    67→
    68→- **FAR = GFA ÷ Gross Site Area** (§§ 25-1-21(43), (48)). GSA is the full unmodified site area — no deductions for floodplain, CWQZ, slopes, or environmental overlays.

A sealed CVC documentation package from a Registered Professional Surveyor or Engineer + City Height Determination Letter required. **§ 25-2-531 exceptions do NOT apply.**

Shoreline setbacks vary by subdistrict (e.g., Rainey 150 ft from Town Lake, North Shore Central 100 ft, South Lakeshore 65 ft). North Shore Central and South Shore Central impose 70-degree angle-plane envelopes; Lamar uses straight caps. Primary setback area = no parking; secondary setback area = ≤30% IC.

    94→### Compatibility Standards (Article 10) — repealed and replaced July 15, 2024
    95→
    96→> **Critical 2024 change.** The former Article 10 used a four-tier framework at 50/100/300/540 ft with a "compatibility waiver" mechanism (former §§ 25-2-1081/1082). The Ord. No. 20240516-004 replacement effective July 15, 2024 uses only **two distance thresholds (50 ft and 75 ft)**. Plans citing the old distance bands, the waiver mechanism, or §§ 25-2-1064/1066/1067 are relying on repealed authority. Plans submitted before July 15, 2024 may retain Chapter 245 vesting to prior standards.
    97→
    98→**Applicability (§ 25-2-1051):** Site is (1) zoned MF-4 or less restrictive (MF-4, MF-5, MF-6, any commercial/industrial) AND (2) within 75 ft of a **triggering property** = 1–3 dwelling units zoned SF-5 or more restrictive (LA, RR, SF-1, SF-2, SF-3, SF-4A, SF-4B, SF-5 only — SF-6 does NOT qualify; vacant lots do NOT qualify).
    99→
   100→**Exceptions (§ 25-2-1052):** CBD/DMU sites; structural alteration without size/height increase; sites used exclusively for duplex, SF attached, SF residential, small-lot SF, two-unit, three-unit, adult care, or child care.
   101→
   102→**Height limits (§ 25-2-1061):** <50 ft from triggering property = 40 ft max; 50–74 ft = 60 ft max; ≥75 ft = base zoning applies.
   103→
   104→**Buffer (§ 25-2-1062 + § 25-8-700):** 25 ft along shared triggering property line (15 ft if site is <75 ft wide), subdivided into a 10-ft **screening zone** (no vertical structures, parking, driveways, or mechanical equipment) and a 15-ft **restricted zone** (parking/drives permitted). Buffer NOT required for condo/townhouse use, ≤16-DU residential-only sites, or NO/LO/LR sites with ≤40 ft height cap.

Vehicle lights from parking, rooftop mechanical, storage, refuse, common amenity areas must all be screened from the shared property line.

December 2023)**: in single-family residential zoning (SF-1, SF-2, SF-3, SF-4A, SF-4B, SF-5, SF-6), now allows up to 3 units per lot on what were SF-only lots, reduces minimum lot sizes, and recalibrates setbacks for missing-middle infill.    221→## Common pitfalls
   222→
   223→- **Confusing FLUM (Imagine Austin policy) with zoning.** FLUM does not establish zoning; rezones still require § 25-2-281 process.
   224→- **Applying repealed Article 10 (50/100/300/540 ft bands)** to post-July 2024 plans. Current code: 50 ft and 75 ft only. Compatibility waivers under former §§ 25-2-1081/1082 no longer exist.
   225→- **Citing § 25-2-1064 / 25-2-1066 / 25-2-1067** for lighting, parking screening, or noise — all repealed; current authority is § 25-2-1063.
   226→- **Treating SF-6 as a triggering property.** SF-6 is less restrictive than SF-5. Only LA, RR, SF-1 through SF-5 qualify, AND the lot must contain 1–3 dwelling units.
   227→- **Applying parking minimums anywhere except inside a PUD with a parking exhibit, or under UNO (where it's a maximum).** Minimums were eliminated November 13, 2023.
   228→- **Citing "Type CT" site plan designation.** Abolished November 13, 2023 along with parking minimums. Only relevant for amendments to pre-Nov 2023 plans.
   229→- **Measuring building height from finished floor or from the lowest grade.** § 25-1-21(50) requires the *average* of highest and lowest adjacent grades at the building perimeter.
   230→- **Citing § 25-2-531 height exceptions on CVC sites.** Inapplicable per § 25-2-642(B). All rooftop elements (mechanical, parapets, elevator overruns) count against the CVC plane.
   231→- **Confusing § 25-2-641 (Capitol Dominance) with § 25-2-642 (CVC).** They are different overlays with different geometry.
   232→- **Counting overlay setbacks as additive to base setbacks** when the overlay replaces them, or vice versa. Check the overlay text — usually the more restrictive governs (§ 25-2-492(B)) but PUDs/regulating plans may supersede.

   234→- **Treating bulk-purpose GFA and parking-calculation GFA as the same number.** Bike rooms and shower facilities only reduce GFA for parking purposes (§ 25-6-472(C)), not for FAR or benchmarking.
   235→- **Subtracting floodplain, CWQZ, or slopes from Gross Site Area for FAR.** GSA is the unmodified site area; only formally dedicated ROW is excluded.
   236→- **Treating SMART Housing as a 40-year covenant.** SMART Housing affordability is 1 yr owner / 5 yr rental (§ 25-1-705). 40-year obligations come from UNO, VMU, AU, DDBP, NBG, Plaza Saltillo, or Rainey programs.
   237→- **Submitting a Conditional Approval letter from Austin Energy Green Building in place of the Letter of Intent at site plan stage.** LOI must be co-signed by AEGB staff at site plan stage (BCM 7.1.3.2).
   238→- **Asserting Chapter 245 vesting in a narrative without a Director's written Vested Rights Determination under § 25-1-541.** The claim is inoperative until issued.
   239→- **Citing a PUD ordinance number without confirming it is the most recently amended version.** Tracking tables (DU, IC, GFA, VTD/PHT) must reflect the current ordinance after all amendments.
   240→- **Assuming Subchapter E categorically does not apply to PUD sites.** Subch. E § 1.2.5(B) is provision-by-provision; commercial/retail/mixed-use PUDs were required to comply with Subch. E as a Tier One condition (§ 2.3.2(A)).
   241→- **Citing the wrong IFC edition in fire-related notes.** Austin adopted the **2024 IFC** per Ord. 20250410-039, effective July 10, 2025 (superseded 2021 IFC).
   242→- **Using the form "Watershed Protection and Development Review Department," "PDRD," or other predecessor names** in approval blocks or AW construction notes — the department name is **Development Services Department**.
